exteriorEnvironment.orientation: Centre east(+X); increasing U turns toward south(+Z in Three)
exteriorEnvironment.lighting: Neutral dome and fixed afternoon reference sun; interpretation, not a dated historic exposure
exteriorEnvironment.limitation: Static elevated Seventh Avenue approximation from the authored station and limited contextual buildings. Not a historical panorama, complete1935 streetscape, parallax-correct local reflection or time-varying indirect lighting. Sky is the neutral interpreted dome; no modern field/forest photograph is used.

constant018Test.uniformInputProtection: OIDN is bypassed for exactly uniform images so the learned denoiser cannot introduce false structure; compositor EXR/encoding path is still tested

denoising.limitations: Color-only atlas denoising can soften tiny light/shadow features near islands. Inspect actual mapped geometry; higher-sample source bakes remain preferable. PNG clipping is explicitly reported.
